arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Returns
arcs.summary: Day 1: A new charmed rubber duck has appeared on the Jeep — the first in several weeks, and notably different from the previous ones. This one is wearing a small hat. No witness has come forward. The Duck Bandit is active again. The Jeep appears unbothered. Steve has examined the hat. It is well-made. Day 2 should develop a second appearance or a new detail — perhaps the hat matches something, or a second duck appears, or someone in the area reports seeing a figure near the Jeep but can offer only a partial and unhelpful description.
